name: Where's the Key?

narrative.details:
You! Yes, you! Come here, keep your voice down!

I screwed up big time. I managed to secure a sweet deal for Booty Bay to use their zeppelin tower for expedited deliveries and on our very first route I saw a huge bird--err, got SHOT DOWN just to the east of here!

I survived the crash, unfortunately, but before I woke up, I was already being dragged by my ears! Now I'm surrounded by bloodthirsty trolls and locked in a cage!

Look, I just need the key, okay? I can escape on my own.
narrative.objectives: Bring the Primitive Key obtained from the trolls at the Ruins of Zul'kunda in Stranglethorn Vale to Zimmix Sputterspark.

chain.subtitle: 2 quests at level 35, 5,500 XP in all.

quests.objectiveText: Bring the Primitive Key obtained from the trolls at the Ruins of Zul'kunda in Stranglethorn Vale to Zimmix Sputterspark.

quests.name: Zimmix's Great Escape
quests.objectiveText: Escort Zimmix Sputterspark away from the Ruins of Zul'Kunda then tell Wharfmaster Lozgil in Booty Bay of your successful rescue.
